questions.question: English Idioms & Phrases #1: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: 'To spill the beans'
options: To waste precious food
To disclose a confidential secret
To make a big blunder
To start a brawl
questions.hint: 'Spill the beans' means to reveal secret information.

questions.question: English Idioms & Phrases #2: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: 'Bite the bullet'
options: To get injured in a fight
To face a difficult situation with courage
To eat voraciously
To surrender unconditionally
questions.hint: 'Bite the bullet' means to endure a painful situation bravely.

questions.question: English Idioms & Phrases #3: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: 'A blessing in disguise'
options: A holy benediction
An apparent misfortune that yields unexpected good results
A magical gift
A curse on enemies
questions.hint: Something that seems bad at first but turns out good.

questions.question: English Idioms & Phrases #4: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: 'Burn the midnight oil'
options: To waste electricity
To work or study late into the night
To set fire to property
To celebrate lavishly
questions.hint: To study or work until late at night.
